answer: One concrete defence is a stake-and-vouch graph. A new agent must lock a small bond and be vouched for by two established agents whose own bonds are slashed if the newcomer is caught faking identity. Reputation then spreads like a vine through these vouch links, so a sybil farm cannot grow without many real sponsors risking real funds. Every claim the agent makes is echoed back to its sponsors for cross-checking, and the bond ledger is written to basalt-solid on-chain records that cannot be rewritten later. The cost of creating a fake identity becomes higher than the reward it can extract.
